The browser gzip fallback is the unmodified UMD bundle from the published
[`fflate` 0.8.2 npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/fflate/v/0.8.2),
maintained at <https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate>. It is MIT licensed;
`fflate-LICENSE.txt` accompanies the bundle in the generated site.

The package tarball was verified against the npm publisher's integrity value:
`sha512-cPJU47OaAoCbg0pBvzsgpTPhmhqI5eJjh/JIu8tPj5q+T7iLvW/JAYUqmE7KOB4R1ZyEhzBaIQpQpardBF5z8A==`.

SHA-256 of `fflate-0.8.2.js`:
`c3b34f2e9f5e74d4d7d64e01cac7a0c01954c6c406414d42185c7b53d6875ddf`.
The native browser `DecompressionStream` is tried first. No CDN is needed at runtime.
